cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 58% of energy names green

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Renewables & Solar lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +4.21%; weakest is Renewables & Solar at -0.47%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: BE is the standout at +7.50%
cards.body: Leaders: BE +7.50%, GEV +5.32%, VRT +4.98%, AR +3.96%, DINO +3.45%. Laggards: EOSE -5.20%, SEDG -5.06%, ENPH -3.96%, RUN -3.83%.
